stem_book: One end of a light string of length L is connected to a ball and the other end is connected to a fixed point O. The ball is released from rest at t = 0 with string horizontal and just taut. The ball then moves in vertical circular path as shown. The time taken by ball to go from position A to B is t₁ and from B to lowest position C is t₂. Let the velocity of ball at B be v⃗_B and at C be v⃗_C respectively. (θ is the angle of OB below the horizontal OA.) (i) If |v⃗_C| = 2|v⃗_B| then the value of θ as shown is (a) cos⁻¹(1/4) (b) sin⁻¹(1/4) (c) cos⁻¹(1/2) (d) sin⁻¹(1/2). (ii) If |v⃗_C| = 2|v⃗_B| then: (a) t₁ > t₂ (b) t₁ < t₂ (c) t₁ = t₂ (d) Information insufficient. (iii) If |v⃗_C − v⃗_B| = |v⃗_B|, then the value of θ as shown is (a) cos⁻¹((1/4)^(1/3)) (b) sin⁻¹((1/4)^(1/3)) (c) cos⁻¹((1/2)^(1/3)) (d) sin⁻¹((1/2)^(1/3))
correct_answer: (i) b sin⁻¹(1/4) (ii) b t₁ < t₂ (iii) b sin⁻¹((1/4)^(1/3))
